description: This file defines data structures and functions related to deep linking within an application, including handling URL parsing, constructing deep link objects, and parsing specific URL schemes such as 'openclaw'. It includes enums, structs, and static methods for encoding/decoding and parsing deep link routes.

classes.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink
classes.description: Represents a deep link to connect to a gateway, including URL parameters like host, port, TLS, tokens, and password. Provides methods for initializing, generating websocket URL, and parsing setup codes from base64 strings.

classes.name: AgentDeepLink
classes.description: Represents a deep link for agent messaging, including message content, session keys, delivery options, and timeout settings. Provides initializer for creation.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON string to create a GatewayConnectDeepLink instance, extracting URL components and verifying the scheme and host.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data, handling padding and character replacements.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL with scheme 'openclaw' to determine if it represents an agent or gateway deep link, extracting parameters accordingly.
